This '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was assigned to transport the recently captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|prison colony]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] for interrogation. However, after the Star Destroyer&mdash;escorted by a pair of [[Victory II-class frigate|''Victory II''-class frigates]]&mdash;jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]], it was [[Battle of Kessel (0 ABY)|ambushed]] by the Alliance's new elite fighting force, [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], intending to rescue Ackbar. The Rebels destroyed the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' class-Star Destroyer's]] communications array so that the ship could not call for reinforcements, and boarded the Star Destroyer. After a short battle, Renegade Squadron managed to free Ackbar and evacuate the ship.
